## Candidate Summary

Nitish Prasad is a Senior Product Manager at Amazon, exploring Principal / Staff individual-contributor roles with ownership of a product area. His experience spans 10+ years at Amazon across marketplaces, payments, and seller systems.

Commercial evidence: $16B+ seller fee-incentive portfolio; three programs associated with 171% targeted ASIN lift and 41% GMS lift; $4.8M free-cash-flow impact in Pay CX; a JIRA-to-Workfront migration across 29 teams and 6,000+ users. Refer to the resume for dates and scope.

Amplify serves approximately 1,600 NA/EU account managers. A before-and-after study of 10 account managers measured average preparation time falling from 45 to 5 minutes. Supporting operational evidence: sub-500ms P95 latency and measured inference spend of $3,000 to $250/month (92% reduction) at the same workload.

Nitish designed and built SproutRoute for family travel planning and Sprout Math for offline math practice. The technical case studies cover model routing, retrieval, evaluation, and agent orchestration. Browser labs use sample data or recorded test results.

The portfolio guide answers four questions about the work, role fit, and Nitish’s proposed approach to a new product area.

## SproutRoute release evidence (September 9, 2026)

The live web planner supports single- and multi-city itineraries, ordered daily driving maps, rule-based packing, and location-specific safety guidance. AI-generated venues, schedules and safety tips require verification; API enrichment is not a guarantee of accuracy.

A production check of an eight-day Tokyo/Kyoto/Hakone trip completed in 24.984 seconds, with the first city ready in 12.191 seconds, measured after route confirmation. This is one observation, not a service guarantee. An 18-call production-prompt benchmark selected Gemini 3.8 Flash for itinerary generation: 13.8-second mean versus 28.1 seconds for GPT-5.4 nano. Flash Lite averaged 10.7 seconds but missed requested activity coverage on some days. The benchmark did not validate venue hours or safety quality.

Release evidence: https://github.com/prasadnitish/SproutRoute/pull/22
